definitions.explanation: Special treatment or benefits given to a particular group, such as members, shareholders, or regular customers. Common in shopping and finance, often in compounds.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会員|かいいん}→会員：02535_kaiin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{入場料|にゅうじょうりょう}→入場料：07056_nyuujouryou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{優待|ゆうたい}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Members get a reduced admission price.

examples.japanese: ⟦{株主|かぶぬし}→株主：15274_kabunushi⟧{優待|ゆうたい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{食事券|しょくじけん}→食事券：28000_shokujiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I received meal vouchers as a shareholder perk.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{優待|ゆうたい}⟦{券|けん}→券：02150_ken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せれば→見せる：01988_miseru⟧、⟦{全品|ぜんぴん}→全品：26366_zenpin⟧{一割引|いちわりびき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なります→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: If you show this discount coupon, everything is ten percent off.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{株主|かぶぬし}→株主：15274_kabunushi⟧{優待|ゆうたい}: shareholder perks (gifts or discounts companies give their shareholders)
- {優待|ゆうたい}⟦{券|けん}→券：02150_ken⟧: discount coupon, complimentary ticket
- ⟦{会員|かいいん}→会員：02535_kaiin⟧{優待|ゆうたい}: member benefits
- {優待|ゆうたい}⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧: special price

CULTURAL NOTE:
⟦{株主|かぶぬし}→株主：15274_kabunushi⟧{優待|ゆうたい} is a distinctive feature of the Japanese stock market: many listed companies send shareholders their own products, vouchers, or discounts, and some individual investors choose stocks for the perks.
